name: Filter — number compares
description: Branches pass / fail. Compare the source number against a single value (= ≠ < ≤ > ≥). Use 'Filter — number in range' for [min,max] ranges. Pair with a Count of binding on source to write 'if there are exactly 2 adults'.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The number to test — pick a numeric field from the request, or use 'Count of' to count items in an array.

params.name: operator
params.description: How to compare the source against the value.

enum.label: = equals
enum.description: Source is exactly equal to value.

enum.label: < less than
enum.description: Source is strictly less than value.

enum.label: ≤ less or equal
enum.description: Source is less than or equal to value.

enum.label: > greater than
enum.description: Source is strictly greater than value.

enum.label: ≥ greater or equal
enum.description: Source is greater than or equal to value.

params.name: tolerance
params.description: Optional rounding tolerance for floating-point fields — passes when |source - value| ≤ tolerance. Leave blank for exact match.

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source resolves to multiple numbers, which match decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one element satisfies the test.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every element satisfies the test.

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when zero elements satisfy the test.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on.
